en:
Hey, Monokuma probably knows about 
our plan, right?

So why isn't he trying to stop us...?
Maybe he's giving us some space?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tsumugi for a while?

Oh...when I think about that, 
it makes me anxious...

Wh-Why don't we have a mixed juice 
drink here to take our minds off of it?

<CLT=cltMIND>I tried one of Tsumugi's
signature cocktails at her lab...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
